title: Teach Vaporize to realize typed VaporwareUnit records into collapse plans and receipts
createdBy: Chief of Staff (clia) per chairman direction to execute Vaporize/Warehouse integration
description: Extend Vaporize so a typed VaporwareUnit can be accepted as an input unit, converted into a build/install/open/run/collapse plan, and written back as a receipt that Warehouse can store. This is the first executable proof of the doctrine: Vaporize builds; Warehouse stores; Vaporware is the main unit of economics.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize has a canonical command or mode that accepts a VaporwareUnit-shaped input record.
The command emits a Vaporize plan with target action, tool route, known vapor risks, and expected receipt kind.
The command emits a receipt with a stable vaporwareUnitId and final state: collapsed, blocked, or still-vapor.
Receipt output can be referenced by a Warehouse entry without parsing terminal prose.
Legacy craze compatibility remains an alias only; new human-facing output says Vaporize.
